techies_mutually_assured_destruction.name: M.A.D.
techies_mutually_assured_destruction.description:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after %explosion_delay%s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
techies_mutually_assured_destruction.shard_description: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.

techies_sticky_bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
techies_sticky_bomb.description: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.
techies_sticky_bomb.lore: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.

techies_reactive_tazer.name: Reactive Tazer
techies_reactive_tazer.description:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
techies_reactive_tazer.lore: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.

techies_suicide.name: Blast Off!
techies_suicide.description: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
techies_suicide.facet_techies_spleens_secret_sauce: Increased Blast Off! damage and self damage.
techies_suicide.note0: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.

techies_land_mines.name: Proximity Mines
techies_land_mines.description: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
techies_land_mines.note0: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
techies_land_mines.note1: Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
techies_land_mines.note2: Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
techies_land_mines.note3: Mines are triggered by invisible units.
techies_land_mines.note4: Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
techies_land_mines.note5: Debuff immune units will reveal mines, but not trigger detonation.
